minutes.headline: EDC plans a ribbon-cutting pilot with Ruby Donuts and a new "Doing Business in Lunenburg" web page
minutes.summary: The Economic Development Committee approved its February and April minutes, reviewed a new "Doing Business in Lunenburg" web page for town website publication, and planned a trial ribbon-cutting ceremony with Ruby Donuts alongside the Regional Chamber of Commerce. Members also discussed how to access EDC funding, a welcome process for new businesses, and deferred a business overview and a public-access interview item to the next meeting.

what_happened.line: The committee agreed to publish a new "Doing Business in Lunenburg" page on the town website, ideally linked from the front page.
It will approach Ruby Donuts for a trial ribbon-cutting ceremony run jointly with the Regional Chamber of Commerce.
The chair, director and vice chair plan to meet the town administrator within about two weeks to learn how the committee can access its own funding line.
The director will draft a welcome-email template for new businesses for the committee to review.
A business overview and a public-access interview item were pushed to the next meeting because the member who proposed them was absent.

why_it_matters: A town-website page and a ribbon-cutting pilot are the committee's public-facing tools for promoting local business, not a budget action.
The committee still does not know its own process for drawing on EDC funding, which is why a meeting with the town administrator is the next concrete step rather than a spending decision.
No votes were taken on substantive business items this meeting; the minutes approvals and adjournment were the only votes.
